## filtlong installation

code to install filtlong

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
conda create -n filtlong_env -c bioconda filtlong
```

## Run filtlong on yeast genome

filtlong bash tool is used to filter the long reads based on certain criteria such as average Q score

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
filtlong --keep_percent 75 data/ERR1539006.fastq.gz > outputs/filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq
```

## Run sequali on filtered genome

```{bash, eval=FALSE}
sequali outputs/filtlong_filtered_reads.fastq --outdir outputs
```
